message.content: {"action":"switch_architecture","reason":"The two prior precision increases improved SQNR substantially (61.0 → 72.8 → 82.1 dB) but also raised area (1185.8 → 1346.5 → 1584.6 um²), so continuing precision scaling is likely to trade more area for diminishing numerical gains. Switching architecture is the only available legal move with an unvisited neighbor and may offer a better balance by changing the LUT/CORDIC structure rather than further increasing precision or table size."}
